user_instruction: Persist Predictorium-style chronological validation as mandatory for this project; reconstruct Denis Tomin's GALAM from four supplied screenshots and find public code if available.

verification_tiers.implementation: A: deterministic causal and state/reset checks
verification_tiers.reference_identity: C: visual diagram plus author descriptions, original source and weights unavailable

reference_claim_gate: Do not claim exact architecture or numerical replication until all source ambiguities and reference parity are resolved.

data_policy.order: train | valid | public | small gap | private
data_policy.primary_validation: Independent official valid; no fit, normalization fitting, teacher fitting, model initialization or adaptive blend fitting on primary validation.
data_policy.ordering_evidence: Do not infer chronology from shuffled seq_ix. Additional chronological splits need actual timestamps or a source-qualified official membership manifest.
data_policy.override: Supersedes prospective random-fold selection for primary research claims; preserve frozen historical runs unchanged.

deliverables: Durable AGENTS/ADR policy and validation admission checks
Source-traced configurable GALAM graph with streaming/reset support
Fidelity gap ledger and independent review
Bounded CPU correctness tests and static checks
Indexed experiment handoff; no scientific score claim

scope.allowed: Local source/code/documentation, bounded single-thread CPU correctness checks, public primary-source search
scope.forbidden: Model fits, GPU use, remote execution, paid resources, Discord messages/reactions, editing frozen historical run recipes

sources_of_ideas: AlexKlos: pretrained GRU memory for Transformer
arsenyinfo: causal multiscale EMA/random projections/weighted ridge
baseline: Existing compact Transformer and recurrent training components; no new baseline fit authorized.
success: Inspectable implementation preserving all resolved graph details; causal prefix/chunk/step consistency and honest unknowns; chronological primary validation policy persisted.
abort_conditions: Source unavailable means exact identity remains unverified, not permission to invent parameters
No runnable training admission without chronological membership evidence
Stop any action exceeding read-only remote and no-fit scope
